newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares strong at mid-session on Rao news.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares strong at mid-session on Rao news.

text.p: Shares climbed on the Delhi bourse at mid-session on hectic buying, boosted by the resignation of former prime minister P.V.Narasimha Rao, seen as a welcome move by investors, brokers said.
The Delhi sensitive index was 5.8 points up at 675.85.
"The news of former prime minister P.V. Narasimha Rao from the Congress party presidentship was welcomed by market people," said Aziz Ahmed of brokers Chinar Finance and Share Brokers.
Rao on Thursday resigned from his last party post as chief of the Congress' parliamentary bloc amid a flurry of corruption charges.
Reliance Industries quoted 2.25 rupees higher at 200.25.
State Bank of India was one rupee up 223.50.
